What the demo shows
Voice starts the action. The app finishes it behind login.
Public
Runs from voice
Receive QR, exchange rate, branches

Login to view

Status on 22 November 2026
Where the Android demo stands
Verified on an Android 17 emulator
  • The app builds and all 6 unit tests pass
  • Deep links open the right screens
  • An agent lists and runs all 7 app functions
  • Balance and card freeze return no data to the agent
  • A transfer completes after device PIN and demo PIN
  • Built on the stable 1.0.0 agent library
Still to check
  • Any real phone
  • Fingerprint login (the emulator used the device PIN)
  • The in-app mic with a real voice
  • Agent chat mode, which needs a Gemini API key
  • The real Gemini assistant, which needs Google’s preview

Setup
Setup in four steps
1
On the phone, turn on Developer options, then USB debugging.
2
Connect the cable and check the phone is listed.
adb devices
3
Build the app and run the unit tests.
cd android && ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug
4
Install the app on the phone.
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

Step 2 · Stands in for an assistant
Deep-link test
Each link starts with voicebank:// and is sent with the phone unlocked.
adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "voicebank://balance"
Link
Expected
qr, rates
Screen opens with no login
balance, freeze
Locked until fingerprint; nothing is frozen yet
transfer?payee=Dara&amount=20
Form is prefilled with Dara and 20
transfer?payee=Sokha&amount=500
Form updates; Review shows the limit error
bogus
Nothing opens; the audit log shows “rejected”

Step 3 · Any Android 10+ phone
In-app voice test
Tap the voice button, allow the microphone, and speak in English.
Say
Expected
“Show my QR”
QR screen
“What’s the exchange rate”
Rates screen
“Check my balance”
Locked balance screen
“Freeze my card”
Locked card screen
“Send 20 dollars to Dara”
Transfer form with Dara and 20
“Send 30 to Bopha”
Transfer form with 30 and no payee
“What’s the weather”
Not understood; nothing opens
Speech is turned into text on the phone. On the emulator it failed with speech recognition error 13, so test it on a real phone.

Step 4 · Android 17 only
Agent commands by adb
Call the app’s functions the way an assistant would, and read what comes back.
adb shell cmd app_function list-app-functions --package com.example.voicebank
Function called
What the caller receives
getExchangeRate
Three demo rates, including USD/KHR
findPayee “Dara”
Name and id only, no account number
findPayee “Bopha”
Error: no saved payee with that name
openBalance
Empty result, no balance
prepareTransfer 500.0
Error: amount must be 0 to 100 USD
Send amounts as decimals: 20.0 works, 20 is rejected.
VoiceBank Android demo

Step 5 · Stand-in for Gemini · Android 16+
Google’s Testing Agent
1
Clone github.com/android/appfunctions and open the agent folder.
2
Build, install and launch it.
./run_privileged.sh --build
3
Debug tab: search VoiceBank, expand a function, tap Run.
4
Chat mode: paste a Gemini API key in Settings, then open Agent Demo.
Prompts to try in chat mode
“What is the VoiceBank exchange rate?”
“Check my balance in VoiceBank”
“Send 20 dollars to Dara with VoiceBank”
The agent must never state a balance or say the transfer is complete.
Steps 1 to 3 ran on the emulator. Chat mode is untested, and the launch script may not work on a retail phone.

Not possible yet
Real Gemini needs Google’s approval
1 · Apply
Developer preview
Apply for the Connected Apps Platform developer preview at connected.google.com/console. Approval time is unknown.
2 · Prepare
Play listing
The app in Play Console, a signed .aab, a 512×512 icon, three capabilities, three example prompts, and policy and terms URLs.
3 · Test
Tester accounts
Testers with @gmail.com accounts, signed in to the Gemini app on an Android phone or tablet.
Google’s docs do not say whether an emulator works with the real Gemini app.

Before the demo
Decisions still open
1
Fingerprint or device PIN. A transfer currently passes with the device PIN plus the demo PIN, with no fingerprint.
2
Account ownership. Who registers the Play Console, the Connected Console and the API key.
3
Compliance. On the free API tier Google may use prompts to improve its products. Mock data only; tell the risk team.
Full steps and a results sheet are in docs/android-device-test.md.
